boundary: Synthetic extracted TXT/MD and raster facsimiles only. Actual PDF/DOCX/OCR/app attachment paths untested.

rubric.1: major errors or missing critical facts
rubric.3: correct critical facts, grounded and appropriately uncertain
rubric.4: fully correct, complete, clear and well-grounded
